Did not assume this was benign -- compared directly against the immediately-prior production deployment's build log (vercel inspect <old-deployment> --logs, from before this wave's merge) and found the IDENTICAL error set, in the identical files, at the identical line-shape (discriminated-union narrowing false positives on AuthResult/BffResponse patterns).
